v5.subtitle: Painted 2D · revised campus roads
v5.dorm.xin_hall: Pale small-tile piers frame recessed brown window bays. A large circular opening, stacked curved balcony fronts and a round gable vent identify Xin Hall. Its wings share one game entrance; interiors are schematic.
lake.note.lake_heart: Kegong Bridge leads to Lake Heart Island and Jimei Pavilion. Your lakeside observation is in the journal.
lake.note.yuning_island: Yuning Island, formerly Watermelon Island, connects to the shore by Keqin Bridge.
lake.note.octagonal_pavilion: The Octagonal Pavilion overlooks the lakeside walk. Follow the path to continue around the lake.
lake.note.progress_pier: The renovated Progress Pier provides access to the waterfront. Observe the lake from here.
lake.note.waterfront_steps: The waterfront steps open toward Success Lake and connect with its surrounding paths.
lake.note.garden_1970: 1970 Garden lies between Success Lake and Shui Mu Student Center, with space to rest and watch birds.
lake.note.west_entry: The west entrance joins Qinghua Avenue to the lakeside walk. Follow it toward the island and pier.
